## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the user-visible problem and what this change delivers. Link the agreed issue or scope when applicable.

## Validation

Record the checks actually run and their outcomes. Include the failing/passing scenario, with its success and failure cases, when changing observable behavior, and explicitly list any checks not run or still failing. Every test passes before each commit, including documentation-only changes.

## Review

- [ ] The change has one clear concern and follows the agreed product scope.
- [ ] Commits are small, staged changes were reviewed before each commit, and every test passed before each commit.
- [ ] Each changed scenario has at least three or four success cases and three or four failure cases; remaining limitations are recorded.
- [ ] Examples, screenshots, and logs use synthetic or redacted data.

Mention any ADR, bilingual PRD, code-generation, or dependency-notice updates required by this change.
